Bond

Where Little Minds Grow Big Ideas!

Bond is a fun, creative space for kids to write, color, and explore their feelings. From journals and mood trackers to reward charts and coloring pages, our printables make self-expression magical.

Bond also helps build stronger relationships between parents and children through shared creativity and reflection. So please download our printables and journals, and enjoy them together with your little ones.

Our Journals

Passport Journal

A travel journal is a fun way to remember adventures and trips! Kids can draw pictures, write about places they visit, and save memories like ticket stubs or funny moments along the way.

Gratitude Journal

A gratitude journal is a special place to write about things we’re thankful for. It helps kids focus on the good in their lives, whether it’s a kind friend, a fun game, or a yummy dinner.

View & Print
Daily Journal

A daily journal helps kids build the habit of writing a little every day. They can share how they feel, what made them smile, or something they’re looking forward to. It’s a great way to reflect and grow.

View & Print
Summer journal

A summer journal is perfect for sunny days and school holidays! Children can write about what they did each day, doodle about their favorite summer activities, or track new things they’ve learned or tried.

Benefits of journaling with children

Boosts Emotional Intelligence

Journaling helps children identify and express their feelings. By writing or drawing about their day, moods, or thoughts, they become more aware of their emotions and how to manage them.

Encourages Creativity and Self-Expression

Journals offer a safe, open space where children can use their imagination, draw, write stories, or reflect on their dreams and wishes — nurturing a love for storytelling and creativity.

Improves Focus and Goal-Setting

Using tools like reward charts or gratitude pages helps children track habits, set goals, and celebrate small wins — building early skills in responsibility and independence.

Strengthens Communication and Parent-Child Bond

Sharing journals (when they want to) creates opportunities for deeper conversations between children and their parents or caregivers. It builds trust and strengthens emotional connection.

Printables

Mindfulness Strategies & Inspirational Words

Positive Affirmations Poster

These “I AM” affirmations help children build a strong sense of self-worth. Print and hang it near a desk or mirror as a daily reminder of how amazing they are.

A–Z Coping Strategies for Kids

This A to Z chart is full of creative ideas children can use when feeling overwhelmed or upset. From “Ask for help” to “Zip up a cozy hoodie,” kids can learn new ways to care for their feelings.

Sticky Notes to Self

These colorful notes offer words of comfort and encouragement. Children can choose their favorite note or even create their own versions to decorate their journals.

Take a Mindful B.R.E.A.K

Help children remember to take meaningful breaks when they’re feeling overwhelmed. This printable teaches a simple acronym to guide mindfulness, calm thoughts, and self-control.

Planing & Chore Chart

Daily Responsibilities Chart

This chore chart helps children keep track of simple daily tasks—from brushing teeth to tidying up. It builds routine, confidence, and a sense of responsibility.

Homework Tracker

A clean and simple tracker that helps kids write down assignments, due dates, and check off tasks when completed. Encourages time management and independence.

My Daily Helper Routine

This playful chart uses icons to guide kids through their day — from waking up to winding down. It's a great visual aid for younger children.

All About Me Worksheet

A fun self-discovery sheet where children can write about their hobbies, favorites, and dreams for the future. Great for first-day activities or memory books.

Reward chart & Stickers

Behavior Chart

This behavior chart helps kids understand expectations by tracking daily actions like being respectful, sharing, and listening. It promotes self-awareness and accountability.

My Reward Chart

Children can earn points or stickers by completing tasks, showing kindness, or reaching personal goals. The rainbow design adds motivation and joy.

Motivation Stickers

These printable motivation stickers are perfect for encouraging self-worth. Use them to boost your child's mood or decorate their journal.

Star Sticker Sheet

These cheerful stars can be printed and used as reward stickers. Perfect for charts, homework, or even lunchbox notes — because every child deserves recognition.
